title: Response body shared by POST /v1/requests and GET /v1/requests/{id}
description: Which branch is legal at which HTTP status is enforced per-example by tools/status_index.json, not by this schema (the status code is a sibling of the body, not a body field): POST /v1/requests answers 202 with the queued-or-running branch or 200 with the available branch (it never returns the failed branch itself -- calling POST again after a failure always creates a fresh queued job); GET /v1/requests/{id} answers 200 with whichever branch reflects the job's current state, including failed.

oneOf.title: queued or running job (POST 202, or GET 200)

upload.description: 1.5.0: present only on POST 202 when the component is not on WordPress.org, no accepted source package exists for (kind, slug, version), and the request listed client_caps ["upload"]. The same site asking again for the same (kind, slug, version) while its upload is still open gets the SAME upload_id back; another site's open upload means no `upload` here (the job waits for that result).

part_bytes.description: every part except the last must be exactly this many bytes; the last must be <= this

max_bytes.description: sum of all parts must not exceed this

reason.description: generic reason code; 1.5.0 adds source_rejected / upload_expired / upload_cancelled for a job whose source upload did not succeed -- the site may request again, and these do not count toward retry_exhausted

oneOf.title: already available, no job created (POST 200, or GET 200)
